message: turmoil::sim::test::elapsed_time_across_restarts sleeps 0.001s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky
why: Simulated time: the sleep runs inside a turmoil sim host on the sim's paused clock (tick_duration 5ms), so it advances virtual time and costs no wall clock - the test then asserts on elapsed().
